_source: Curated from public OFAC country-based sanctions programs (https://ofac.treasury.gov/sanctions-programs-and-country-information). Simplified for a portfolio demonstration — NOT legal advice. Levels: 'embargoed' = comprehensive US embargo; 'partial' = targeted/sectoral restrictions (end-use / end-user driven); 'unrestricted' = no country-based US embargo.
_default_note: No comprehensive US country-based embargo on record. Standard end-user / end-use screening still applies.

cuba.name: Cuba
cuba.note: Comprehensive US embargo. Most exports prohibited absent a specific OFAC/BIS license.

iran.name: Iran
iran.note: Comprehensive US embargo. Broad prohibition on exports and re-exports.

north korea.name: North Korea
north korea.note: Comprehensive US embargo. Near-total prohibition on exports.

syria.name: Syria
syria.note: Comprehensive US embargo on most exports of goods, technology and services.

crimea.name: Crimea region (Ukraine)
crimea.note: Comprehensive embargo on the Russia-occupied Crimea, Donetsk and Luhansk regions.

russia.name: Russia
russia.program: Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions + BIS Russia export controls
russia.note: Extensive sectoral and item-based controls; a very wide range of dual-use and technology exports require a license (many with a policy of denial).

belarus.name: Belarus
belarus.note: Broad export controls aligned with the Russia measures; many dual-use items require a license.

venezuela.name: Venezuela
venezuela.note: Targeted sanctions (government, defense, oil sector). Screen end-user and end-use carefully.

myanmar.name: Myanmar (Burma)
myanmar.note: Targeted sanctions on the military and affiliated entities; defense and dual-use exports restricted.

china.name: China
china.program: BIS military end-use / end-user (MEU) and advanced-computing/semiconductor controls
china.note: No comprehensive embargo, but significant controls on advanced computing, semiconductors, and military end-use — many high-tech items require a license.

afghanistan.name: Afghanistan
afghanistan.note: Restrictions tied to sanctioned parties (e.g. the Taliban); heightened end-user screening required.
